arrival.speaker: Elder Sun
arrival.say: Welcome to Harvest Crossing. Rumours are twisting every sign, price and promise.

arrival.speaker: Elder Sun
arrival.say: Listen carefully in the market, help our neighbours, and follow evidence up the hill.

reform.speaker: Doubt Serpent
reform.say: I made every question coil into another question. I thought uncertainty made me powerful.

reform.speaker: Elder Sun
reform.say: A good question opens a path. A rumour only hides it.

reform.speaker: Spirit Brush
reform.say: Truth Stroke restored. Hidden writing can now be revealed.
